# SWITCHBLADE™

> SWITCHBLADE™ is a brand philosophy — strength, compassion, and intent distilled into a mark
> for builders who refuse to be boxed in. The site tells the story of that mark (Cosmos → Classic
> → Evolution) and the archive of real-world references — in football, motorsport, music, fashion,
> film, and design — that shaped it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://switchblade.in/): The brand's origin story and the three-phase journey of the
  SWITCHBLADE star (Cosmos, Classic, Evolution).
- [Classics](https://switchblade.in/classics): An interactive archive of the people, objects, and
  moments that inspired the mark — one card per reference, spanning football, motorsport, music,
  fashion, screen icons, and more. New cards are added on an ongoing basis.
- [Collaborate](https://switchblade.in/collaborate): How SWITCHBLADE™ partners with other brands
  and creators — the principles it collaborates under (craft first, mutual elevation, cultural
  fit, built to last) and the kinds of collaborations it takes on (sound & art capsules, single
  considered objects, apparel).

## Notes

- The Classics archive is content-managed and grows continuously; treat it as a living page
  rather than a fixed snapshot.
- SWITCHBLADE™ is a brand and creative studio, not a SaaS product or documentation site — there
  is no API or developer surface to describe here.
